title: ABBAS KA DIL DUQTAR E SHABBIR SAKINA
body:
ABBAS KA DIL DUQTAR E SHABBIR SAKINA.
HAI SABR KE QURAN KI TAFSEER SAKINA.
1. BACHI KO MILA SHAAM E GHARIBAN SE SUKOON KAB.
JO ZULM HUWAY BAAD E SHAIHE KARBOBALA SAB.
MOUJOOD HAI RUQSAAR PA TEHREER SAKINA.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. BINTE SHAIHE MAZLOOM KI HIMMAT HAI ANOOKHI.
TOUHEED KI TA SHAAM NA KYUN JAYE TAJALLI.
HAI JURRAT E SHABBIR KI TANVEER SAKINA.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. AYUB KE BHI LAB PA MILI TERI KAHANI.
HAMSAR HAI TERA KOI NA KOI TERA SAANI.
ZEHRA KI HAI TOU BOLTI TASVEER SAKINA.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. BAAD E SHAIHE MAZLOOM NA TUKHKO MILA AARAM.
AATI NHI TOU KISTARAH TUJHE NEEND SARAY SHAAM.
BISTER THA TERA SEENAYE SHABBIR SAKINA.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. BIBI KE MASAEB KA TASAVVUR NAHI AASAN.
EHSAAS YE KEHTA HAI LIKHON SHAAM KA ZINDAAN.
ASHKOUN SE QALAM KARTA HAI TEHREER SAKINA.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. PHIR NAZR E KARAM KIJIYE ZAIR PE QUDARA.
ROUZE PA BULA LIJIYE JOUHER KO DUBARA.
AYE ABID E DILGEER KI HAMSHEER SAKINA.
AZZ: JAWAD ALI JOUHER
